decisions.reason: As a newly launched but strategically related laser-marking line with several models, it still has option value, though its more manual workstation format is somewhat less central to the firm's Industry 4.0 direction.

This thermal inkjet printer is very close to the firm's core offer and customer applications, so in a growing market a large R&D-active firm would usually keep it on the market while learning about demand.

The piezo inkjet printer also fits the established coding portfolio and merits being kept as an option, although its more specialized positioning makes abandonment slightly more plausible than for the thermal inkjet product.
